headline: Lockheed Martin has unveiled the new PAC-3 Adapted Capability Effector (ACE) interceptor for the Patriot air defense system. Designed to reduce the cost of air and missile defense, the PAC-3 ACE is expected to cost less than half the price of a PAC-3 MSE interceptor, potentially under $2 million compared to roughly $4 million for the PAC-3 MSE. Serial production is planned within the next three years, with manufacturing shared between the United States and Europe. The PAC-3 ACE is intended to intercept less sophisticated ballistic missile threats, allowing the more capable PAC-3 MSE to be reserved for the most demanding targets. In other words, it will be just as useless as the PAC-3 MSE against Russia's Iskander-M ballistic missile.

headline: CENTCOM: A U.S. service member was killed in northern Iraq on July 18 during a controlled detonation of unexploded ordnance from a downed Iranian attack drone. A second was wounded. Unidentified remains were also found in Jordan at the site of a July 17 Iranian attack that left two dead and one missing. Verification is ongoing.
